lt.line: Pabaigęs šias kalbas, Jėzus pasitraukė iš Galilėjos ir atėjo į Judėjos sritį, anapus Jordano.

en.event: Thursday of the Nineteenth Week in Ordinary Time
en.line: So will my heavenly Father do to you, unless each of you forgives his brother from his heart.” When Jesus finished these words, he left Galilee and went to the district of Judea ac
